mentions.name: Sweet Shop
mentions.description: A digital comic book store where readers can discover and buy comics, described as 'Letterboxd with a buy button', working with signed publishers to help comic creators earn more from their art.
mentions.problem: Comic creators work hard to make art with minimal financial rewards; the store aims to make them more money so they can make more art.
